name: Clipboard History
description: A personal clipboard history that records nothing until you turn recording on. Install does not record, activation does not record, and the recording switch defaults to off.

settings.title: Record clipboard history
settings.description: Until this is on, ND records nothing. Turning it on starts the clipboard watcher; turning it off, disabling the extension, or uninstalling stops it immediately.

settings.title: Text entries to keep
settings.description: Oldest unpinned text entries beyond this cap are removed. Pinned entries are exempt.

settings.title: Image entries to keep
settings.description: Oldest unpinned image entries beyond this cap are removed. Pinned entries are exempt.

settings.title: Pinned entries to keep
settings.description: How many entries you may pin at once. Clearing history keeps pinned entries.

views.title: Clipboard History
views.description: Nothing recorded yet. Copy something while recording is on and it will appear here.
